name: 13d-convert-cohere-tool-primer
description: The 'else' half of the tool-call branch in convertCohereMessages (prompt-converters.js:398-400): when a tool-call message is NOT immediately preceded by an assistant turn, its content is replaced by a human-readable primer built from the tool names -- `I'm going to call a tool for that: ` plus `tc?.function?.name` joined with ', '. The second tool call has no `function` at all, which is what pins the optional-chaining semantics: in JS the missing name contributes the EMPTY string that Array.join gives `undefined` (`[undefined].join(', ')` === ''), so the result ends in a trailing ', '. A port that stringifies a missing member as 'None' produces 'get_weather, None' and diverges. Note the message is FIRST in the array, so the `index > 0` guard at :395 is false and this is the branch taken, not the splice.
